vb_textbox.text: From what I observed playing the game, the number of mushrooms obtained on average will change regardless of which option is chosen (ie there are up and down swings in the game). I also found that the Brown and the Turquoise option give higher payouts on average and are more likely to give 8 or 9 than the other options. But as there are periods where the best option changes, you should not pick these exclusively, as the other options may be better for periods during the game. The highest amount of mushrooms I got was 9 (from brown and turquoise) and the lowest was 0 (from brown). I also couldn't observe any difference in left vs right
